targets.title: Irrelevant changing-state vibrotactile stimuli disrupt verbal serial recall: Implications for theories of interference in short-term memory.
targets.evidence_quote: Experiment 1 served as a close partial replication of Marsh, Vachon, et al. (2024; Experiment 1), which reported a vibrotactile changing-state effect in a visual-verbal serial recall task.
targets.outcome_quote: To preview the results of the present study, we were unable to replicate the vibrotactile changing-state effect reported by Marsh, Vachon, et al. (2024), across four experiments. These findings run counter to our primary hypothesis and call into question the robustness of the original effect.
